notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Captains![/h1]

We’re back with Progress Report 5 and we are excited to announce that the new update coming next week for [b]Closed Beta Test[/b] program. 

One thing we pride ourselves on at Sernur.tech is our relationship with our players. Today, we continue to be amazed that the enduring passion for Trigon: Space Story continues and that the community continues to respond positively to our work.

[b]Thank you for your support and here is the good news we prepared just for you! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/e582cb17d28c319468d6bd380bbbd00ee7d8bb2d.png[/img]
[i]Black Market at the pirate Space Station[/i]

[h2]How to play the Beta?[/h2]

So, if you want to play through the changes, and become a part of the Closed Beta Test program let us know about it this weekend. 

We are ready to start the third wave of the Closed Beta Test. And ready to share 50 new keys for that. 

If you want to participate in testing - hurry up to do it.

🎯  [b]Playtest goals[/b]

🔹 Play the game.
🔹 Identify bugs that the development team missed.
🔹 Fill feedback form.
🔹 Help developers improve the game.

❓ [b]How can I take a part in the Closed Beta Test? [/b]
🔹 You need to fill out a simple form for a key request - here https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdCaMP6hhlAaRKYJSbbItV6dtBCHDQGTQkvei_koEDzO4HtAA/viewform. 

🔹 We collect 50 questionnaires from our Discord and Steam Community and will contact you. 

🔹 You will need to activate the key that you will receive by mail in Steam. 

🔹 Сomplete all 4 Chapters in the game. Or play enough to answer our questions. 

❓ [b]How to activate beta key?[/b]
🔹 Activating a Product on Steam https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=5414-tfbn-1352#:~:text=Launch%20the%20Steam%20client%20software,instructions%20to%20complete%20the%20process

❓ [b]How to provide feedback?[/b]
Please fill out the feedback form in the game or via the link. https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScGhz4DMSyKCcjmDt2uQoOov5EAWsJ4hDirwSGVOyBtByXgkA/viewform It is very important to us and helps to make the game better. 

🐞 [b]Bug reports[/b]
Please leave error messages in a special thread on the discord channel.

⚡⚡⚡ [b]Disclaimer[/b] ⚡⚡⚡

⚡ WARNING! We changed too many parts of the game and we had to say the new version of the game does not support previous saves. We are sorry. We are trying to make the game better and more interesting.

⚡ We are aware of the performance issue. We are still in development progress. We will optimize performance once we finish working on every game mechanic.  

⚡ And we broke translations. Now it is machine translation but don't be afraid we will make it right in the end. 

🔹Bear in mind that everything is still being tweaked according to feedback, so some things may break, have strange interactions, or just straight-up crash the game. 


[h1]What's coming[/h1]

[previewyoutube=z925zkpTKMY;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]This is for history. Short gameplay video how it looks and feels November 2021.[/i]


[h2]UI History of changes[/h2]

The last update is more dedicated to the reworking of the UI. We carefully analyzed the feedback from the players, divided it into categories, and the largest of them turned out to be somehow related to the UI.

We are not professionals and this is our debut project. We learn a lot on the go and as it turns out, UI is the hardest task of all for us.

Let's plunge into history and see how we have come from the beginning to the present day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/3c90ec658b5ef867beb49df6aecf69a5a8c85f0f.jpg[/img]
[i]This is the first version we have. A lot of things missing. It was more about how the game could be in 2,5D and how we can place UI elements on the scene. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/61c5f53d504df45f55cc735ffea639936be134e3.jpg[/img]
[i]We start looking for some style and try to make it small as possible to clear the game scene cause we have a lot to show. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/c48892bceb5efc984f079c930744106e52781cb9.jpg[/img]
[i]After lots of attempts we get to this round minimalistic style. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/e212dd466be87d187a52932bbc2625516af83980.png[/img]
[i]And this was our Alfa version we have had for a long time[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/957d24706bf8e53d11a7426977d41a2c5febc547.jpg[/img]
[i]Almost a year of work and we have the Beta with this polished picture and new UI. Now everything that we need works well. But we have issues with understanding what is the current state of Systems HP, Enemy System HP, Shields, and a lot of reports about all this by beta test players.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/d40da6bc8a0e9561f2bc5efb43b68ca4b015df2a.png[/img]
[i]We are still in the process of working on the UI and this is still not the end of the work on it. We've reworked absolutely everything. Read on for more details.[/i]

[h2]UI Key changes:[/h2]

🔹 On the game scene in the interior of the ship, we no longer show the Doors HP until they start breaking. This made it possible to set accents and focus the player on the indication of the state of the Systems.

🔹 Added outlines to all interactive objects in the scene. Doors, Units, Systems are now highlighted on hover. This reduced the number of misclicks.

🔹 Added a blinking effect when taking damage. It is now easy to see which Unit or Door is receiving damage in the game scene.

🔹 We've reworked all health bars. If earlier all of them were white. We have introduced color indications green, yellow, red. That made it much easier to understand the situation even with a cursory glance.

🔹 Changed the work of the scale showing the state of the Shields. Finally, it is clear what happened to them. Level, overload, overcharge, etc.

🔹 The state of the enemy ship. Previously, it was only two bars of HP and Shields and it was impossible to understand whether you broke the weapon System or not. Now, this is not a problem.

🔹 Many other changes to make the game easier to control. From a more visual state of the player's weapons to the reworking of all pop-ups.

[b]We still have a lot of work to do to improve the UI and we really hope to get your feedback on this. In addition to the main screen for release, we will rework the Ship Management and Space Station screens.[/b]


[h2]Features[/h2]

🚀  [b]Units new game mechanic[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/06c2935ae3b0bca6eee2eed49038a3974bec2499.png[/img]

We have begun work on reworking Units. Units now gain Experience and Level Up. Experience is awarded for actions on the scene (repair, extinguishing a fire, fighting with another unit), quests, and battles with enemy ships. The maximum Unit Level is 4. Two passive perks are given to choose from when Leveling Up. You can choose one of them. Passive perks have racial restrictions, some abilities are available to some races and not available to others. On the 4 Lvl Unit get Active Abilities to choose from.

 🚀  [b]Complete Story Mod[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/ae3eef070d8fc9e157a31380749bec2ebb480ca8.jpg[/img]

We have completed work on all Сhapters of the game's Story Mode. There will be 4 Campaigns available in the game. You will be able to learn the history of one Galaxy through the eyes of the captains of each race.

🔹 [b]Added 43 Side Quests[/b]

🔹 [b]Enemies surrender[/b]
During surrender, the dialogue now shows what the player will receive if he accepts the enemy's surrender.

🔹 [b]Game Auto Pause when battles begin[/b]
The game is now automatically paused at the start of a battle. It is optional and you can turn it off as you want. 

[h2]Localization:[/h2]

🚀  Added new languages ​​(German, French, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish, Mexican Spanish).
Added new localization for all languages ​​(so far only machine translation). 

[h2]Visual:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/3c5ee1b2178e521a0e3ac85b413a0cacab228cd7.png[/img]

🔹 Added projectile lighting to the scene - a passing projectile now illuminates the outer part of ships.

🔹 Added Rakkhs Space Station.

🔹 Added a cool effect when the game is paused.

[previewyoutube=DVhNKuizy1o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Balance:[/h2]

🔹 The Venators have become a bigger threat. With an increase in the wanted list, their number in one battle can increase.

🔹 Now there is a chance that enemy will escape from the battle. For ships with a crew only. Drones don't escape.

🔹 As always, a bunch of minor edits in ship configs, stations, a set of random ships for quests, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/4d578aaf108a00626198061175378ae991d006eb.png[/img]

More details on our discord channel and the Steam Community. For those of you who want to help us, we provide an opportunity to test the game in its current state. We would be grateful for your feedback and suggestions for improving the game. And I will try to answer each of them.

Please feel free to jump to our discord channel, submit to Closed Beta Test, join a closed group and take your limited part in the developing process with us. Thank you!

[b]Exciting times ahead, Commanders.
Stay tuned for more news soon! =)[/b]

notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Captains. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/c67ada89a4b88addb7b3f5cbf269fe479574b450.jpg[/img]
[i]Etari Yeonden Spaceship at home[/i]

[h2]From Announced To Now[/h2]

As we prepare to launch the new build version 0.4 - more on that below - we’ve also been looking back at our journey with Trigon: Space Story. On August 28, 2019, we started to work at our debut game - to a wonderful reception from most space strategy fans. 

Since then, we have 
[list]
[*] [b]Wishlisted over 50'000[/b] on Steam alone
[*] Launched and [b]downloaded DEMO over 25,000[/b] players on Steam
[*] We get to [b]#245 in Wishlists[/b] from all announced games on Steam
[*] We carefully collect and analyze the feedback from the CBT and DEMO players, and are happy to have the current [b]average score - 78 [/b]
[*] Gained new CBT community members with 94% of players playing for more than 1 hour - and 46% of players playing for more than 10, numbers we are extremely proud of
[/list]

[b]So, yeah. We’ve grown a lot since the beginning. All thanks to you. [/b]

We have also expanded our internal team and now hiring new great talents to help work on Trigon: Space Story and future games to come. I hope we will be fully staffed soon and the development process will speed up. I can't wait to get to the point where we tell ourselves that the game is well done enough to be shared with everyone.

[h2][Version 0.4.1.378][/h2]

[previewyoutube=tI4w48UfQa0;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]This is for history. Short gameplay video ver 0.4.1.378 how it looks and feels September 2021. [/i]

[b]WARNING! We changed too many parts of the game and we had to say the new version of the game does not support previous saves. We are sorry. We are trying to make the game better and more interesting.[/b]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Space station store now updating every 3 days.[/b]

[list]
[*] Now the assortment at the market changes over time. This gives more variability in building your spaceship set up, as well as allows you to get enough supplies in protracted exploration within the same sector.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/04500550e7d8e7e509244839d021a52ff4eb45ef.png[/img]
[i]Rakkhs Space Station concept art[/i]

[*] [b]Damage radius reduced for cluster missiles.[/b]

[list]
[*] Bigger is not better. Too large damage areas often led to the fact that the damage gets not on the enemyes ship systems, but only on the hull.
[/list]
[*] [b]Reduced Door's health.[/b]

[list]
[*] It is now easier to move through the compartments on an enemy ship. Boarding battles have become more dynamic. Now doors subsystem upgrades have become useful not only for fire protection but also for holding back enemy units.
[/list]
[*] [b]The number of Systems on Galaxy Map with anomalies has been slightly increased.[/b]

[list]
[*] Battles in locations with anomalies are always more interesting and difficult. We slightly increased the chance of generating such locations in the sector. They can play into the hands of the player or, complicate his life. Whether or not to fly to the Pulsar is up to you.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/aa6bace60316bdfa6c0a04469889c087535bf38f.jpg[/img]
[i]We tried to recreate most of the cosmic phenomena. For example, here a young quasar begins to swallow a star. There is still a lot of work ahead, including on new locations. We are trying to make them fascinating.[/i]

[*] [b]Quests generation has been changed.[/b]

[list]
[*] New rules for generating side-quests: SOS quests, trade quests, courier quests, research quests, combat quests, and others
[/list]
[*] [b]Automatic return player's units to the player's ship upon victory by killing enemy crew or surrender.[/b]

[list]
[*] Since the teleport mechanic has improved, the number of boarding battles has increased. To speed up the gameplay, you no longer need to wait until the teleport is ready to take units back. This now happens instantly if you win by destroying the enemy crew or if they surrender.
[/list]
[*] [b]The maximum evade level has been changed from 90% -> 100%.[/b]

[list]
[*] The Stealth System itself grants 60% evasion. But in conjunction with the engines and the Pilot level, you can now get a 100% chance of dodging for short time.
[/list]
[*] [b]Balance of Weapons, Drones, Ammunition, Systems, Cooldowns.[/b]

[list]
[*] A ton of balance changes. Now the game can be completed with almost any set of weapons.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/53a1836a9b25bd2f51d4c7e6a7393bb0426feab8.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Venators no longer attack in Space Station systems.[/b]

[list]
[*] Locations with space stations are now demilitarized zones in which any battles are prohibited. Feel safe.
[/list]
[*][b] Venators no longer arrive after the Gatekeeper battle.[/b]

[list]
[*] Gatekeeper battles are a challenge for any player. Venators can no longer fly to you immediately after defeating a Gatekeeper. But if you return to this gate later, Venators can fly through this location and find you.
[/list]
[/list]
[previewyoutube=xsRDiNKnemY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Features:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Killing an enemy captain = victory.[/b]

[list]
[*] One of the main injustices has been resolved. Now the rule of death of the captain = defeat also works for enemies. This opens up new tactical opportunities for the player. An enemy captain can be killed with a weapon with high damage to units, you can hunt him while boarding, you can try to grab him aboard with a teleporter. All of this is especially useful if the enemy ship has a lot of HP. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/e14e2f093ef39629348a673dafe8a3b900ba2268.jpg[/img]
[i]Boss fights never be easy[/i]

[*] [b]The enemy team surrenders. [/b]

[list]
[*] If the player has a cryo-chamber on board, enemy units can be placed in it. If there is not enough space in the cryo chamber, a window will open with the distribution of units that did not fit, similar to the distribution of items that did not fit in the hold.
[/list]
[*] [b]Added "Police" and "Black Market" modules to space stations.[/b]

[list]
[*] The ability to sell frozen units to the station. At regular stations - in the Police module for reducing wanted level. At the Pirate space stations - on the black market for credits.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/52cfe15b43de56021f72e7e8bbfaf514af706b60.jpg[/img]
[i]What do you prefer to have less wanted level and fewer resources or high-risk high reward?!?[/i]

[*] [b]Stealth system.[/b]

[list]
[*] When activated, it temporarily increases the ship's evasion up by 60%. While the Stealth is working on the ship, you cannot aim. If you will shoot while Stealth activated it will be immediately turned off. You can teleport units with the Stealth system activated. Enemies also have a Stealth system and know how to use it. The Stealth system now can be found at the space station.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/875526e46a403020b4689fae6aafe739db4a7d0a.png[/img]
[*] [b]Enemies AI are now much better at teleport behavior.[/b]
[*] [b]Chapter 2 is now available only after completing Chapter 1.[/b]
[*] [b]Restart the game. [/b]

[list]
[*]  Now you can restart the game session with the same ship and crew but in a newly generated universe. The "Restart" button has been added to the in-game menu.
[/list]
[*] [b]Leaderboard. [/b]

[list]
[*] Shows the player's best score among all players or friends.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/d37e9316dbf5db4ddc9f1c786b13a1b3c98f8c1a.png[/img]
[i]Now it is more challenging [/i]

[*] [b]Added Statistics for player's sessions in the main menu. [/b]

[list]
[*] Shows history of game sessions results.
[/list]
[*] [b]Added Steam Achievements. [/b]

[list]
[*] The list of achievements will continue to grow. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/2a43e27c247830ae3fe823d25a37ec73d7825286.jpg[/img]
[i]I like to get trophies and achievements so there will be plenty of them and some of them really hard to get. But I believe players will play better than devs. [/i]

[*] [b]Scouts ships without crew now have an auto-repair system.[/b]

[list]
[*] It is gradually repairs damaged systems.
[/list]
[*] [b]Added Weapons and Drones slots to the space station trade screen. [/b]

[list]
[*] With their help, you can find out what weapons and drones are installed and sell the installed ones. When buying new weapons and drones, they are immediately installed in free slots.
[/list]
[*] [b]Added the "chunks" parameter to the description of Weapons and Drones[/b]

[list]
[*] It is the number of shells in one salvo.
[/list]
[*] [b]Added new music tracks for Human, Etari, Rakks, Taertikons.[/b]

[list]
[*] We are very fond of music in games and we dream that our OST will find fans one day.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/69d0190e86ddcc3788974e37fcb493fca6b49708.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Fixed a bug with the enemy's corpses remaining on the player's ship.[/b]

[list]
[*] Now the player's ship does not turn into a graveyard of enemy units. All bodies are taken out at the moment of the change of day. Cleanliness is the key to health.
[/list]
[*] [b]Fixed a bug with the enemy captain's avatar going off the edge of the screen very slowly.[/b]
[*] [b]The number of player's units is limited to 8.[/b]
[*] [b]The default language is now English.[/b]
[*] [b]Many minor bugs have been fixed.[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Localization:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]English texts have been improved.[/b]

[list]
[*] We are continuing to improve the English texts with the help of one of our players. Aidan, thanks a lot.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Quests:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/53622662a61ffa2657757201ee38ca8740769c30.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*][b] Lot's of Chapter 1 Quest fixes.[/b]
[*][b] Lot's of Chapter 2 Quest fixes.[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Visual:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Galaxy Map redesigned. [/b]

[list]
[*]  Now it looks like a galaxy. You can Zoom In on the location using the mouse wheel. The galaxy map gameplay is not finished yet, but visual was an important part. 
[/list]
[previewyoutube=gjrPy_3HkIo;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]It is better to see on video. We want to give more freedom in galaxy exploration and want to make it big enough. [/i]

[*] [b]Waypoint UI tips improved.[/b]

[list]
[*] The number of links between systems increased. It helps travel from one side to another faster and helps to avoid Venators patrol. Waypoint tips also improved, it helps with a quick look where to go. 
[/list]
[*] [b]Floating Impact status effect texts such as "stun", "knocked out" were added.[/b]

[list]
[*] Now you will see when the enemy unit gets a status effect. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/dc2f818405269e61aa36769e80c5149195964e97.jpg[/img]

[*] [b]The buttons "Save the position of units", "Return units to their positions", "Open doors", "Close doors" have been visually improved.[/b]

[list]
[*] It is easier to see that they exist and use them. 
[/list]
[*] [b]Improved the visuals of the interior of the ships.[/b]

[list]
[*] We are in an endless search for a compromise between detailed interiors and a readable scene.
[/list]
[*] [b]As always, a huge bunch of all sorts of visual improvements and fixes.[/b]
[*] [b]The day counterchanged. Now it's Day 1, Day 2, etc.[/b]

[list]
[*] Instead of starting off with an imaginary sidereal date, we ended up with a change of days. This makes it easier to track the time in the game. At the first time player can be "happy" that he survived for a couple of days longer.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Ok[/h2]
We’ve always enjoyed the transparency we’ve had with the community, and so we hope this Dev Thoughts is insightful to how we think about development going forward. Please let us know your thoughts and ideas. As always, thank you for making this possible.

[previewyoutube=5ahuTsdtQg8;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]This is how we feel when a new build is delayed for weeks. And Medbay System is your support. Thank you![/i]

More details on our discord channel and the Steam Community. For those of you who want to help us, we provide an opportunity to test the game in its current state. We would be grateful for your feedback and suggestions for improving the game. And I will try to answer each of them.

Please feel free to jump to our discord channel, submit to Closed Beta Test, join a closed group and take your limited part in the developing process with us. Thank you!

notes.title: Trigon: Space Story - Progress Report 3
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Captains.[/h1]

[code][i]“That's one small DEMO for a player, one giant leap for us”[/i] - Incredible! The launch of Trigon: Space Story DEMO changed our lives forever.[/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/206ec84f675bc0323e1833083215d76d4adcc05c.jpg[/img]
[i]We will make major updates to the DEMO till full release and it will always be available on Steam[/i]

Indescribable feelings. Excitement and fear. 
- Three, two, one. And before the release, Steam asks to confirm the release of the application by writing it in words. Oh my God!

First downloads, first players, first comments. As a chained person, I watched the activity of the players.
It is absolutely crazy how many people came to our page. There are so many of you! Over [b]46k wishlists[/b] and over [b]22k demo installations[/b]. Thank you very much for your interest and support. Thanks to the Universe that we have the opportunity to share our game with so many players. 

[code]"900 years of time and space and I’ve never met anyone who wasn’t important."
                                                                — Doctor Who[/code]
[b]Thank you to each of you who are interested in the game and took the time to try playing the DEMO.[/b]

[h2]Your Feedback is the best thing we have[/h2]

In addition to the DEMO itself, we have prepared feedback forms to start working with your observations and suggestions.

We have carefully collected all your comments and responses to our questionnaire. Hundreds of questionnaires and about three hundred suggestions. Incredible! From the first day, we dreamed that the game would have its own audience, along with which we would go from early access to full release. And it seems this is happening. Thank you for every comment. Even negative comments help us improve.

Well. Let me show you what we have done during this time and tell you what will happen next.

[h2][Version 0.3.12.5765][/h2]

[b]WARNING! We changed too many parts of the game and we had to say the new version of the game does not support previous saves. We are sorry. We are trying to make the game better and more interesting.[/b]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/c4b86fdce1b785800f79963dacbf49ad2c064867.jpg[/img]
[i]Let's jump into new gameplay! You definitely need to try it. I mean it ))[/i]

"Acid Balance" is a completely new balance of everything:
[list]
[*]     all weapons, drones, and ammunition - the rate of fire, damage, price, rarity
[*]     all bosses - strength, weapons, crew
[*]     all enemy ships - strength, weapons, crew
[*]     loot - the chances of a drop of weapons (you can get legendary weapons!), ammunition, the amount of supplies and fuel
[*]     wanted lvl - slower raise the wanted lvl while staying in one sector
[*]     stations - filling the store, the cost of upgrading and purchasing systems
[*]     ship systems - upgrade costs
[*]     quests - chances of generation and distribution
[*]     shields - reduced speed of regeneration
[*]     Improved the location of systems on the map when generating.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[previewyoutube=fq_TUmrFE90;full][/previewyoutube]
[*]   Teleport - teleport warming up mechanic has been added. Before triggering, the teleport warms up for 5 seconds, during which you can have time to react and take your units out of the compartment so that they are not taken by enemies.

[previewyoutube=3dtkm5zx7DA;full][/previewyoutube]
[*]   Cryo-chamber - the isolator has been replaced with a cryo-chamber. The units in the cryo-chamber do not consume supplies, but they cannot do anything, because they are frozen! At any moment, they can be unfrozen, due to the receipt of a temporary debuff. 
[i]A little later, the ability to sell frozen units at stations will be added. At regular stations in the police module for lowering the wanted number. At pirate stations in the slave trade module - for money.[/i]
[*]   Added pirate, Etari, and Taertikon space stations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/c6d3d7d25d57f243337d8e60edc339834cc87d04.png[/img]
[i]Taertikon space station with little easter egg[/i]
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]UI:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/cbf42bc5fe89ec755084cc3de7f19b36d7b54811.png[/img]
[i]I love to look at and analyze graphs and statistics of the game session. Helps me as a player to understand my mistakes, and helps us to adjust the balance.[/i]

Added statistics of the game session at its end - 6 statistics screens with all numbers and graphs:
 [list]
[*]     Exploration - quests, jumps, systems, etc.
[*]     Fights - victories (in different ways), escapes, boss fights.
[*]     Resources - everything about the resources received and spent, supplies, fuel, ammunition, etc.
[*]     Ship - the condition of the ship in time, credits, and scrap spent on repairs and upgrades.
[*]     Crew - everything about the team, how many were in the team, how many died of hunger, died in battle, were thrown overboard, etc.
[*]     [i]The "Top" screen is not yet complete - it will display global statistics for all players and among Steam friends.[/i]

Map:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/b3cc49cc15d73e61d5a98aba651b81674b18f931.png[/img]
[*]     List of active and completed quests.
[*]     Description of anomalies.
[*]     A legend with a description of all the map icons.
[*]     Rewards of the same type are now summed up in dialogs when given out.

Scene:
[previewyoutube=cwNQP81t6Nw;full][/previewyoutube]
[*]     Added the ability to zoom in and out of ships using the mouse wheel.
[*]     Added storing and restoring the positions of units in the compartments.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Quests:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/ffc439084f6848a17841e152af9c5462f14dcfd9.png[/img]
[i]High fire chance laser feel so good [/i]

 [list]
[*]   Chapter 2 Added  - Captain Etari's main quest and side quests.
[*]   Added 30+ new quests.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Localization:[/h3]

Our endless thanks to [b]Aidan Catriel[/b] one of our players!
[list]
[*]   English texts are proofread and corrected (except Quests texts). 
[*]   Many small text fixes.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Ships:[/h3]
[list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/fe5910d4ce0344b5f108d8fda857d1182ef8ee39.png[/img]

[*]  Added 20 enemy ships.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Visual:[/h3]
  [list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/4632adcbeeedbe4c1ec8d0d2aa0a7bdc69e6d323.png[/img]
[*]   Added avatars for key characters: Captain of the Centenary Falcon, Captain of Yonden, Maraya, Popo, Ronnie, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/35ce214adc2633a37e18a02c151d87d407a6ebf7.gif[/img]
[i]We have received many reports about unnecessary parts inside the compartments. Redesigned and cleaned bays for better visibility. How do you think now?[/i]

[*]   A Huge number of visual improvements and fixes. Polishing of ships. Polishing of locations.
[*]   Improved position of enemy ships on the screen. And their healthbar and shieldbar.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]

[h3]Optimization:[/h3]
 [list]
[*]   Improved work with fonts, now they are loaded only when needed.
[*]   Temporary solution - we have limited the aspect ratio of the screen. Now it is only 16:9. Of course, in the future, we will make all possible resolutions.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]


[h1]What about the similarity to FTL? [/h1]

I will create a new topic in the steam community to keep the discussion in one place and not spreading in many small topics. 

In short, I have a chat with FTL creators, and here is what we get about this:

[quote=Sernur.tech]This was incredible. I have no words. They are great people full of wisdom and love. I will not post a quote without their wish, but they cheered me up and were very impressed with what we have done for now. There is no hard feeling in their minds with me. I shared the keys for them to try the complete version. And even got some advice from them.[/quote]

[h1]What coming next?[/h1]

[b]We will be finishing up with:[/b]
[list]
[*] Global Steam Leaderboards - comparing with friends, top players ect.
[*] New Galaxy Map and jump mechanic 
[*] Teleport new AI behavior 
[*] New mark point cursor
[*] Auto-substitution of shells when installing a new weapon
[*] Auto loading shells if you run out of some, but there are others in the warehouse
[*] Several battles in one location: If the player's units are stuck on the first ship, teleport them back automatically
[*] Quick ways to Restart the game
[*] Fix famous bug "Corpses on Player's Ship: Outline"
[*] Ships: Engine Off Animation
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] 4 new Ambient for each race
[*] Killing the enemy captain = winning the battle
[*] Interface for capturing enemies
[*] Station police module interface
[*] Interface of the slave trade module in the pirate station
[*] Mac build
[*] Change the game time display to day 1, day 2, etc.
[*] Enemy escape rework
[*] Venator changes
   Venators do not spawn on boss systems unless the boss is killed
   Venators do not fly into boss systems unless the boss is killed
   Venators do not attack in systems with stations (demilitarized zone), they can be in them and fly.
[*] Changing the work of stations - updating the assortment
[/list]

[h3]Tierd? Too much text? Ok, I will show you something special. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/6c950bdc0137db8c3a9c58c6a668b11802fd90ca.png[/img]
[i]We will have 85 Steam Achievements at EA release. Some of them are really hard to get[/i]

We work at the Galaxy map and exploration part of the game and trying to have the new scale for this one

[previewyoutube=M4G0Obq3LhI;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]It's still a draft, I'm sure you'll like it when we're done.[/i]

[h1]Want to play and help?[/h1]

We will continue to share the new builds with our players to get feedback. More details on our discord channel and on the Steam Community. For those of you who want to help us, we provide an opportunity to test the game in its current state. We would be grateful for your feedback and suggestions for improving the game. And I will try to answer each of them.

Please feel free to jump to our discord channel, submit to Closed Beta Test, join a closed group and take your limited part in the developing process with us. Thank you!

[url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/38789852/c445b26f513bd79e51fa39eb993aedc7ed0e8d67.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/c445b26f513bd79e51fa39eb993aedc7ed0e8d67.jpg[/img][/url]

Thank you for your anticipation and faith in the project. Thank you for your support and for telling your friends about us.

[b]Stay tuned[/b]

notes.title: Trigon: Space Story DEMO
notes.content:
[h1]The demo is coming on JUN 15th![/h1]

The last few months have been very productive for our little studio: We reached the home stretch to the Early Access release on Steam. We double game content (on Russian for now): Chapter 2, new side-quests, new enemies, new space stations. We implemented the game session statistics and steam leaderboards. We completed Trigon: Space Stories with our beta-testers and collect all minor issues to our work plan on this road to the Early Access release. 

Right before Steam Next Fest, we’re ready to invite everyone to play the demo version of Trigon: Space Story! 

[h3][b]When is the demo version released?[/b][/h3]
The demo version will be available from JUN 15 at 10:00 am (PDT) right before the Steam Next Fest and will remain active right up until the release of the game.

[h3][b]What will be in the demo version?[/b][/h3]
- The demo version will be released on Windows and will have all the languages that appear in the full version of the game.
- The demo will provide you tutorial and 1 galaxy sector to play. 

[h3][b]What about live-stream?[/b][/h3]
We will start broadcasting JUN 16 at 10:00 am (PDT) here on Steam. Please join us I will be there and feel free to ask any questions about the game, development process, our plans, etc. Follow us on Steam to get reminders of coming events. See you on live-stream. 

[h3][b]What next?[/b][/h3]
Right now, we heading back to work on the game. We will continue working on our roadmap to full release. The next step is the Early Access release on Steam. It means we need to make localization of new content, complete all bugs our testers found, add unlocks and Steam Achievements, make some minor updates in the game, polish balance, and graphic optimization. 

Thank you for your support and passion for the game. All of us at [url=https://www.trigonspacestory.com/en/]Sernur.tech[/url] hope that you enjoy playing Trigon: Space Story. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Trigon: Space Story - Progress Report 2
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Captains.[/h1]

We haven't been contacted for a long time. For us, this month passed like one day, but much more time has passed for you. [b][i]"This Little Maneuver's Gonna Cost Us 51 Years"[/i][/b]
Finally, the signal passed and you will find out everything that we have done during this time. Let's go.

[h2]Trigon: Space Story nominees IndieCup W'21 and DevGAMM finalist on Indie Celebration Competition 2021[/h2]

We got nominations for the Indie Cup W'21 - [b]Best Audio[/b] and [b]Best Unity Game[/b].

We also became the [b]DevGamm Finalists of the Indie Celebration Competition 2021[/b] by Digital Dragons. Thanks to DevGamm and Digital Dragons for their support and appreciation of our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/a72d6afb6320d1a015aa92e17b990d560469aa24.png[/img]

These are our first reviews from critics and that's great. I hope that they are not the last and we will collect many awards and assessments that are important and meaningful for us. Although I am ready to exchange any critics' awards for the only important one - the positive reviews from the players.


It's crazy, but there are already more than [b]30,000[/b] of you. Thank you to each of you. Finding someone with similar interests is a great success. And we got [b]30,000[/b] successes. The whole team is closely following your comments. And I follow with trepidation how a community of active players is being formed, who share our hobbies and vision of the game. I am ready to devote more time to communicate with you on our discord channel and will gladly answer any of your questions. Join us, let's get to know each other better.


[h2][Version 0.3.0.5206][/h2]
[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Added a tutorial to the game[/b] that teaches the basics of the game. It starts when you first click on the "new game" and when you click on the "tutorial" button in the main menu.
[*] For the last battle with the boss Maraya, a separate cool location has been made.
[*] Now gates to other sectors are initially blocked (and visually on the map too). To unlock, you need to defeat the miniboss in a location with a gate.
[/list]
[h3]Balance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Evasion bonus per engine level reduced
    0.12 -> 0.11
    0.16 -> 0.14
    0.20 -> 0.17
    0.24 -> 0.19
    0.27 -> 0.21
    0.30 -> 0.23
[*] Increased the charging speed of the hyperjump from the hyperdrive level.
[*] Reduced the cost of repairing a ship for scrap
    40 Scrap for 10 HP -> 30 Scrap for 10 HP
[*] The amount of fuel and supplies dropped after the battle has been reduced by approximately 17%.
[*] The repetition of locations, location names, unit avatars, unit names has been minimized.
[*] Now a pirate station can be generated.
[/list]
[h3]UI:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The "gate" object in the location with the gate is now interactive - when you click on it, you jump to another sector.
[*] The "station" object in the location with the station is now interactive - when you click on it, you go to the station.
[*] Added hotkeys to answer options in dialogs.
[*] The popup with information about the unit now does not disappear while the unit is selected.
[/list]
[h3]Visual:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the visual of special options in dialogs.
[*] Added visual glitches of the interface for powerful hits on the player's ship.
[*] Fixed position of enemy ships' healthbars.
[*] [b]Lots of minor visual improvements and fixes.[/b]
[/list]


[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[h2]Music[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/0399617720d141e7fd14960c02ea5a76930cb0fd.jpg[/img]

A significant part of our work is working with sound. We invite you to enjoy and appreciate some of the tracks from our soundtrack.
Please enjoy the Original tracks Set from Trigon: Space Story

https://youtu.be/xk9CXbl9Wqc 

We will continue to work on the soundtrack for the game. According to the plan, we need to prepare 14 more tracks, and each of them in its place will make the gameplay and immersion into the game more complete. Hope you like our style. Let me know in the comments.


[h2]Spaceships[/h2]

We are working on modifications of the enemy ships. Now you can find a ship of each race belonging to different fractions. For example, the Etari ship model for slavers. Or Rakkhs bio-mechanical ships converted for the needs of the Federation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/94684b0c698581932dceba73e0eab7da74f5bb8b.png[/img]
[i]The interweaving of organic matter and metal in Rakkhs technologies[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/b597a3dea09ad54448d34b6348c4a4ddccb82473.png[/img]
[i]A luxurious Slave Patrol powered by Etari technology.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/064ae9c1cfe54fcc831bfb0a793fe214c560c10a.png[/img]
[i]Since I was a kid, I loved highly detailed drawings, now is the time to share this passion with the players. Please take a look at this Federal Scout Spaceship. [/i]



[h2]Camera Zoom In / Zoom Out[/h2]

I would also like to note that we listen to your opinion and we have the first living example of how this helps to make the game better. One of the players suggested adding freedom to the camera and zooming in and out of the camera. And God, how we used to live without it?! We will publish this feature in the next update.

[previewyoutube=alJHyuH4XiE;full][/previewyoutube]
Have you noticed movement in the background? We want to test how the dynamics of movement interfere with the perception of the game.


[h2]Hull damage effect[/h2]

[previewyoutube=Cm-tJVb4jPg;full][/previewyoutube]
Added shaking and flickering of UI elements when taking damage to the hull. Honestly, I didn't even immediately notice this at the weekly review of the project. It is so organically perceived as if it was already.


[h2]Space stations[/h2]

We started adding the generation of space stations of different races and factions. A pirate station can already be found, Etari station will be ready soon. Concepts for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/c22c131cdd30189505a650243eca10f733b6ecf4.jpg[/img]
[i]I love the theme of the pirate station. Being a pirate - why not?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/39a58352101306a5b075db62d52785f56e207f60.jpg[/img]
[i]The monumental and majestic Etari stations, with their level of technology, are by far the most convenient and desirable of all races.[/i]

We continue to work on the stations of the mysterious Thearticons and the beloved Rakks.


[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/5195a5da0a9fa02f1eed9ac2790b55b46f5cc096.png[/img]
[i]We should definitely work on the texts in the tutorial[/i]

We have made a large tutorial that will explain the game's basic mechanics in the format of a small event preceding the main game. This is a lot of work and we will follow the feedback on it to make it even better. The main thing is to help the player understand the abundance of information and rules of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/3b7cedbf237db75e9dd0e0c2b0f34585ed3b306a.png[/img]
[i]I died once while completing a tutorial - achieved[/i]

[h2]Leaderboard[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/ac74a9487e513a3dcb83ff201125c2a4cc5dcf4b.png[/img]
[i]Working on collecting game session statistics for the leaderboard will indirectly help us achieve a better balance[/i]

Working on leaderboards. Shortly after losing or complete the game session, the player will receive session statistics. We want to make it informative and interesting to study. We love numbers and graphs. And we plan to make an online leaderboard so that you can compare your progress with your friends. I can't wait to see your results in the game.



[h1]What do we have next according to the plan?[/h1]

[b]We will be finishing up with:[/b]
[list]
[*] The camera Zoom-In/Zoom-Out, camera shake effect
[*] Leaderboards
[*] Etari, Rakkhs, Taertikons Space Stations
[*] New balance improvements
[*] Teleport delay mechanic
[*] Stealth system
[*] Cryo-chamber
[*] The slave trade and the ability to capture the enemy crew
[*] Chapter 2 Etari 
[*] 45 new sidequests
[/list]

[h2]Content pack[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/032d514b6588af230ed2618371d2b55c68db2ad5.png[/img]
[i]Updated our quest editor. Things will go faster now.[/i]

We have already written 3 of the 4 main story arcs and prepared 45 additional sidequests. And now we have started implementing the second chapter and a new pack of sidequests into the game. There will be many more events in the game soon. It will take time to localize them, but I guess we will post them as soon as they are ready in English.

[h2]Publisher News[/h2]

"If you want to make God laugh, tell Him about your plans". I tried to make predictions about signing and Early Access dates based on publisher work but got it wrong twice. It seems it's time to admit that you shouldn't guess dates and annoy the audience without having experience in selling games.

I can say that [b]everything is going well[/b]. We received a good offer and are handling the legal part of the deal. 

I will report signing in a separate post. Wish us luck.

[h2]Want to play and help?[/h2]

I'm very excited to say that we are starting a closed beta test program this week. More details on our discord channel and on the Steam Community. For those of you who want to help us, we provide an opportunity to test the game in its current state. We would be grateful for your feedback and suggestions for improving the game. And I will try to answer each of them. 

Please feel free to jump to our discord channel, submit to Closed Beta Test, join a closed group and take your limited part in the developing process with us. Thank you! 

[url=https://discord.gg/Sx3ZypU2VU][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/c445b26f513bd79e51fa39eb993aedc7ed0e8d67.jpg[/img][/url]

Thank you for your anticipation and faith in the project. Thank you for your support and for telling your friends about us.


Join Trigon: Space Story Discord:
 https://discord.gg/Sx3ZypU2VU
Discuss Trigon: Space Story here:
 https://steamcommunity.com/app/1226510/discussions/

We will continue our development of Trigon: Space Story and let you know when we have more news.

[b]Stay tuned[/b]

notes.title: Trigon: Space Story - Progress Report.
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, captains! [/h1]

It's a pleasure to return to you with another progress report. This time we take a look at what's upcoming in Version 0.3.0.4678. And some more details about Early Access. 

[h2][u]Trigon: Space Story on IndieCup W'21[/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/96254ef98b8f842f98735467d44d83e6e59464b5.jpg[/img]
[i]New trade spacestation art. [/i]

We are now on IndieCup W'21 waiting for which nominee we can get. Wish us good luck. Results will be on April 6. Fingers crossed. 
[b]IndieCup W'21:[/b] https://indiecup.net/en/participants/trigon-space-story.html

[h2][u]What's new?[/u][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/ea6c94681f884377d97f96b4341b06e9767aeaf7.jpg[/img]
[i]Art of Maraya Palace. Now in progress to implement to the game. [/i]

Shame on me, I still cannot say an exact date, but I can say what we made for it and what is left. 

ːsteamthumbsupː We finished localization to all specified languages. 
ːsteamthumbsupː We have the green light to release on Steam (passed through all their check)
ːsteamthumbsdownː Did not sign with a publisher. 

The only thing left, is to sign an agreement with a publisher. So what does it mean and what exactly happened? We closed any negotiations with a couple of local publishers, cause their offer in the final was not good for us. And I have some spider feeling about them. This was not our way. But we need to have PR & Marketing support. The choice is about to go to self-publish or sign with a publisher. 

And somehow, we got new incoming well-known publishers. So last weeks we are in new negotiations. If I only could press 'F' to make lawyers faster, I will. 

Could we do it earlier? I guess no. All incoming offers we started to get after we have shown the gameplay for all of you. And I think your activity, wishlist, and comments are what make us interesting for publishers. And helps us to be shown to your friends and new players who did not hear about us yet. 

[h2]Let's talk about you. [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/c37e68f3fd79a6b2d2e5984734fd4e47a21eb3c5.png[/img]

It is absolutely phenomenal to have such an audience as you. First of all, thank you, everyone. Me and team read all your comments everywhere we can find them, and this is what makes us happy and nervous a little bit. There is so much of you. And we feel a lot of responsibility. Can't wait to get you playing and send us suggestions on how to make the game better. 

Thank you for your patient and support. [b]There is 16'000 of you now.[/b] I can't believe that. This means a lot for me and I see how it helps the whole team works with a twinkle in their eyes. [b]Thank you.[/b] 

[h2][Version 0.3.0.4678][/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/ddd43452fed9776d0273e1a3c6fe07ee4e99183f.jpg[/img]
[i]Work in progress - new gates UI and visual[/i] 

I understand that is hard to read when you don't have a game. But all this time while you are waiting we make the game worthy for you. So this is what we did last week. 

[h3]Optimization:[/h3]
  [list]
[*] Game loading time has been reduced
[*] The loading time of the ship selection screen when clicking on "new game" has been reduced
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
  [list]
[*] Bug leading to the UI appearance only after enemy shot fixed
[*] Bug causing an error when hovering over a compartment when a ship explodes fixed
[*] Bug with not updating the bounty value on the main screen after the quest fixed
[*] Bug with an alert sound when leaving the system with danger fixed
[*] Bug with disappearing information about units and systems after jumping fixed
[*] Bug with playing a bunch of unnecessary sounds when loading the ship selection screen fixed
[*] Bug with incomplete health of a unit with the "vitality" perk fixed
[*] Bugs with rarity and stack in item popup fixed
[*] Bug with the icon of the enemy ship remaining on the map after the battle fixed
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/482cf230418d8e97ddcbd4e02ed7b62e4bc31f49.jpg[/img]
[i]Solar storm in action. I think we get right balance with fire spreading. [/i]

[h3]UI:[/h3]
  [list]
[*] Portrait of the enemy captain in the battle with the miniboss added
[*] Number of the selected gun/drone is added to the cursor
[*] Buttons "station", "leave sector" have been moved. They are now positioned directly above the jump button
[*] Added a red glow around the edges of the screen for low captain health
[*] Added palm and rotation cursors on the map
[*] Added sound when specifying a target for shooting
[*] Now each threat has its own separate sound (fire, breach, pulsar, etc.)
[*] The colors of the system icons on the screen and on the interface are synchronized
[*] Bonuses from the operator are split into different lines in the description of the system. It should be clearer now
[*] Design of the information window in the upper left corner has been changed. Now alerts are located above it, there is no bottom border so that the window can accommodate all the text
[*] Language name in the menu in the language selection is now in that language instead of English
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/9dc627851172e20e6116aa0d6aebf6a346db6862.jpg[/img]
[i]On the right - my heart when you post that we don't care about the release date and your feelings.[/i]

[h3]Visual:[/h3]
  [list]
[*] Beautiful loading screen added
[*] System explosion effect on scene improved
[*] Visual of the repair and upgrade window at the station improved
[*] Changed the visual of flying off numbers and icons on the scene on the player's ship and the enemy ship
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/15106d765852385762d403033c693517e58e0761.jpg[/img]
[i]Help & Tips: You should find a trade station in every space sector[/i]

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
  [list]
[*] In some quests, the bounty penalty has been significantly reduced
[*]   50% chance of losing a crew member in the first step of the main quest removed
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/266b1b08b0943ee7cf3a491bbc7fafe6ddc8c264.jpg[/img]
[i]Explosions and shield overload[/i]

[h2][u]When will Trigon: Space Story be released?[/u][/h2]

The truth is we don't know either. As it turned out, it's not enough just to make a game. It still needs to have good PR to get to the audience. And if we figured out the development process, marketing issues for us still seem difficult. After we will sign the agreement with a publisher or PR agency they need their time for PR & Marketing. But it won't be so long. [b]Q2 2021[/b]. 

We will not waste time and will work on the game according to the plan that I showed you before.

We are currently working on:
[list]
[*] Tutorial
[*] Leaderboard
[*] Epic final battle in the first quest. 
[/list]

[b]Discuss Trigon: Space Story here:[/b] https://steamcommunity.com/app/1226510/discussions/

We will continue our development of Trigon: Space Story and let you know when we have more news.

[b]Stay tuned[/b]

notes.title: A bit of history and development plans
notes.content:
Hi there! 

When we were kids, we would play our favorite video games for hours. We grew up, but nothing has practically changed – we still enjoy our hobby. Just like you do, we have a list of favorite games. Among them is FTL. It seems, only yesterday we played it after classes, however, ten years have passed. We waited for the sequel, but, unfortunately, the authors announced there wouldn’t be one. And that’s how we decided to make a dream game ourselves. We’ll try to make the perfect sequel, keeping the best and adding things that were missing.

This is our first project, and it boasts everything we love about gaming and want to share with you and the new generation of gamers. All this includes stories of spaceship captains, the most amazing places in the Universe, cool spaceships, blasters/lasers and battles, our own music and exploratory spirit. We’d like you to feel like a captain rather than a ship. We’d like you to write your own space story as part of the [b]Trigon: Space Story Project[/b].

[h2]Development Story
[/h2]
The idea to create our own computer game first appeared in May 2019. So, we got an inspired team together, and on August 28, 2019 the five of us kicked off the implementation in a specially-designed studio. It took us 3 months to assemble a prototype that was to be showcased at DevGAMM gaming conference in Minsk, Belorussia. Both players and publishers welcomed the project. Such support encouraged us to go on with the project on full scale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/47b3c80df0a9ecf87564ba8536380eb47092c545.png[/img]
[i](In November 2019 the game was represented by one fight only and 2D grahics.)[/i]

We invited two more people to our development team and assembled the alfa-version by June 29, 2020. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/561e0a74d517e7353ea8ef522513a9e8a0c04645.png[/img]
[i](It was 3D now, and by the time of the alfa-version, there was one sector to move around and a possibility to improve the ship, as well as one quest with variable endings.)[/i]

These days we can say that the Early Access version is ready. With it, you will enjoy our generated Galaxy, some quests, rich arsenal, and your own space story. Though, there is still a lot to do about the balance and some scheduled tasks. I’m going to introduce you to the plan now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/6ec5164c5ab4a975c009825002614ea5dcf5e28b.jpg[/img]
[i](The game in the Early Access as of February 4.)[/i]

We would like to publish this Early Version to be able to gather such enthusiastic people as you are – space fans, lovers of science fiction and games – to continue the elaboration of this project together. 

[h2]Here is what the present roadmap looks like.  [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38789852/56c6c242168652d826000d852f4c518576156307.jpg[/img]

1.	Initially, the intended audience for this game was to consist of people acquainted with FTL. However, it turned out, that within these 10 years a great number of gamers grew up that are unfamiliar with this game. And it’s they who need an interactive tutorial. We’d like to have it in the form of a prologue to the game. You’ll be able to skip it or call it from the Main Menu at any time.

2.	We plan to communicate with our players as much as we have time and resources. One of our major tasks now is proper balance. To polish the balance we need to gather some metrics. We’ll add game progress mechanisms, including unlocking of new ships, Steam achievements, to be able to track the depth of progress. Besides, it’s another place for some more references, nice designs, and magic of figures.
 
3.	The next update will bring you a lot of new mechanics and change some current ones. We planned to create a free Universe exploration that would allow you to make your own decisions about the pace of your progress in the sectors. For those of you, who like to thoroughly prepare for a battle and peek into the most distant parts of the Galaxy, we’d like to add planets exploration, gathering and recycling of various resources. It’s not going to be grind for the sake of grind. We just want to create more planets, stories, and reasons to visit them.

4.	The most important update is our new system of unit upgrade. We have finally found an ideal way to make your crew the key element of your adventure. And to make your units more personified and to your taste. It will definitely boost your emotions from the events happening to them and will bring some changes to the gameplay. We also plan to change specializations, add perk level-up tree, and lots of active abilities available for any unit.

5.	The next upgrade will have to do with captains. Within the session you’ll face other captains. Some of them are easy to deal with diplomatically, others understand only the strong arm. At the station you will be able to find wanted lists of captains. You’ll be able to take up the bounty-hunting job, but be careful not to get onto the list.

6.	Content Pack-2. The Universe is a large thing. And we’ll add even more locations, even more events and quests. New ships available for a player, new belligerent captains and ships. New armory and weapons. Unique units, with their own perks and abilities.

7.	Localization. The renewed content localized into English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Russian, Standard Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.  

We are eager to make Trigon: Space Story a true ambassador in space rouge-like strategies. In the modern world, it is impossible to do without the contribution of the community. You are most welcome and appreciated to join and support the project. 

[h3]P.S.[/h3]
I still cannot give the exact release date, sorry. But we switched to working with weekly iterations, and all this time it benefits the build quality while we resolve issues with publishers.

I would be glad to receive your comments, ideas and wishes. And you can support us by telling your friends about the game. 



Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226510/Trigon_Space_Story/
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3EaR1l-pwFA&t=43s
Discord: https://discord.gg/Sx3ZypU2VU
Twitter: https://twitter.com/SpaceTrigon

notes.title: Release delayed for several weeks
notes.content:
[h3]Dear friends. We are very sorry that we did not manage to resolve all issues related to the release on time.[/h3]

I and the team are very pleased and painful at the same time to see that there are so many of you and you are still waiting for the game to be released.

Be as honest as possible about the release situation. We did not manage to finish localization into the specified languages.

The good news is it doesn't take long. Let us update build with new languages, pass the steam test and we are ready.

I also consider it important to inform that several publishers are now actively negotiating with us. If we sign with any of them, the situation may change. All of this will be resolved in the next couple of weeks.

During this time, we will focus on polishing and testing. We'll post a development and update roadmap separately.

[h3]The target [b]price is $19.99[/b] and we'll start with a 10% early access launch discount.[/h3]

[h2]And I present to your attention the updated trailer, I hope it will at least slightly help brighten up your expectations.[/h2]

[previewyoutube=3EaR1l-pwFA;full][/previewyoutube]

On behalf of the entire team, I apologize thousands of times for each of you.
We're looking forward to sharing our game with you, streaming together and seeing your progress.

I'll keep you posted.
